senses.gloss: f. (= <cite ref="E00341"><he>הֵי דָא</he></cite>, <he>הֵי דָא הִי</he>, v. <cite ref="A01161"><he>אֵידֵין</he></cite> a. <cite ref="E00363"><he>הַיְידָּא</he></cite>)
what now?, who now?, where now? Targ. Y. I Deut. IV, 7; 8 (II הַיְידָּא).). Targ. II Esth. VIII, 7.—

(ellipt.) ה׳ ל־, ה׳ לי־ what is this here in reference to? what hast thou to do with—? Gen. R. s. 87 הן אדני הי׳ לדקמך (Yalk. ib. 145 הידה לקומך) ‘here is my lord’ (thy husband), what hast thou to do with the one before thee (me)?—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 5:1:3">Y. B. Kam. V, beg. 4ᵈ</cite> <he>איידי ליקימיך</he> what claim hast thou against me?—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26:1">Lev. R. s. 26</cite> <he>הידא לִיגַבֵּי שנאך וכ׳</he> (not <he>לי גבי</he>) why dost thou call on thy enemy &c.?—[<he>הַיְרָּא</he>, v. <cite ref="E00363"><he>הַיְידָּא</he></cite>.]
